Step 3: Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Step 4: Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a barbell across your upper back.
Step 2: Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using your calves.
Step 3: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 4: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 2: Hold onto the cable machine handles or attach a cable ankle strap to your ankles.
Step 3: Raise your heels off the ground by extending your ankles as high as possible.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Step 2: Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the platform.
Step 3: Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform, with your heels hanging off.
Step 4: Push the platform away from you by extending your ankles, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Step 5: Continue pushing until your calves are fully contracted.
Step 6: Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower the platform back to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between ankles)
instructions:
Step 1: Stand facing a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 2: Place an exercise ball between the wall and your lower back.
Step 3: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Step 4: Place a tennis ball between your ankles.
Step 5: Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Step 6: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: exercise ball on the wall calf raise
instructions:
Step 1: Stand with your back against a wall and place an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
Step 2: Position your feet shoulder-width apart, with your toes pointing forward.
Step 3: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Step 4: Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: calf stretch with hands against wall
instructions:
Step 1: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step 2: Place your hands against the wall at shoulder height.
Step 3: Step your right foot back, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Step 4: Bend your left knee and lean forward, keeping your back leg straight and your heel on the ground.
Step 5: Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Step 6: Switch legs and repeat the stretch.

Step 1: Stand with your toes on an elevated surface, such as a step or block.
Step 2: Place your hands on a stable support, such as a wall or railing, for balance.
Step 3: Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height just below your shoulders.
Step 2: Stand facing the bar with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing forward.
Step 3: Place the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or platform, with your heels hanging off.
Step 4: Hold onto the bar for support.
Step 5: Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Step 6: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: single leg calf raise (on a dumbbell)
instructions:
Step 1: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Step 2: Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Step 3: Slowly raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.

Step 1: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your thighs.
Step 2: Place the balls of your feet on a raised surface such as a step or block, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Step 3: Hold onto the dumbbell for stability.
Step 4: Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: lever seated squat calf raise on leg press machine
instructions:
Step 1: Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the footplate.
Step 2: Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the footplate, shoulder-width apart.
Step 3: Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the footplate, keeping your heels off the edge.
Step 4: Release the safety handles and push the footplate away from you by extending your knees.
Step 5: Once your knees are fully extended, slowly lower your heels by flexing your calves.
Step 6: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the footplate back up by extending your calves.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: dumbbell seated one leg calf raise
instructions:
Step 1: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your right thigh.
Step 2: Extend your left leg straight out in front of you, keeping your foot flexed.
Step 3: Place the ball of your right foot on an elevated surface, such as a step or weight plate.
Step 4: Using your calf muscles, raise your right heel as high as possible.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

Step 1: Adjust the leverage machine to the appropriate height for your body.
Step 2: Position yourself facing the machine, with your toes on the foot platform and your heels hanging off the edge.
Step 3: Place your hands on the handles or the support bars for stability.
Step 4: Engage your calves and lift your heels as high as possible, using the balls of your feet.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: calf push stretch with hands against wall
instructions:
Step 1: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step 2: Place your hands against the wall at shoulder height.
Step 3: Step back with one foot, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Step 4: Bend your front knee slightly and lean forward, feeling a stretch in your calf.
Step 5: Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Step 6: Switch legs and repeat the stretch.

Step 1: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to comfortably stand with your feet flat on the ground.
Step 2: Position yourself under the bar with your shoulders directly below it and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 3: Place the balls of your feet on a raised platform or weight plates, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Step 4: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step 5: Engage your core and keep your back straight throughout the exercise.
Step 6: Slowly raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Step 7: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 8: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand facing a wall or sturdy object, about an arm's length away.
Step 2: Place your hands on the wall or object at shoulder height.
Step 3: Step back with one foot, keeping your heel flat on the ground.
Step 4: Bend your front knee slightly and lean forward, keeping your back leg straight.
Step 5: You should feel a stretch in your calf muscle.
Step 6: Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Step 7: Repeat on the other leg.

Step 1: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Step 2: Bend one knee and place your foot flat on the ground.
Step 3: Using your hands or a towel, gently pull your toes towards your body, feeling a stretch in your calf.
Step 4: Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Step 5: Release the stretch and repeat on the other leg.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Step 2: Place your hands on a stable surface for support, such as a wall or a bar.
Step 3: Lift one leg off the ground, keeping your knee slightly bent.
Step 4: Raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Step 2: Place your hands on a wall or stable surface for balance.
Step 3: Slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a barbell resting on your thighs.
Step 2: Place the balls of your feet on a raised platform, such as a block or step.
Step 3: Position the barbell across your thighs and hold it securely with your hands.
Step 4: Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, lift your heels off the ground by extending your ankles.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step 2: Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using your calves.
Step 3: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 4: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to stand with your feet flat on the ground and your shoulders under the bar.
Step 2: Position yourself under the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Step 3: Place your hands on the bar for stability.
Step 4: Engage your calves and slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Step 2: Bend your knees slightly and lift your heels off the ground, balancing on the balls of your feet.
Step 3: Keeping your knees bent, rotate your knees in a circular motion, first clockwise and then counterclockwise.
Step 4: Perform the movement for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on a wall or sturdy object for balance.
Step 2: Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Step 3: Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body up onto the ball of your foot.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Step 2: Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, standing on your toes.
Step 3: Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 4: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: smith one leg floor calf raise
instructions:
Step 1: Position yourself on the floor under the smith machine bar, facing away from the machine.
Step 2: Place the balls of your feet on a raised surface, such as a weight plate or block.
Step 3: Position the smith machine bar across your lower legs, just above your ankles.
Step 4: Hold onto the bar with your hands for stability.
Step 5: Raise your heels off the ground by extending your ankles, lifting your body up.
Step 6: Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Step 2: Place your feet on the sled platform with your toes pointing forward.
Step 3: Push the sled platform away from you by extending your ankles and calves.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the sled platform back to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Step 2: Lift one leg off the ground and rotate your ankle in a circular motion.
Step 3: Perform the desired number of circles in one direction, then switch to the other direction.
Step 4: Repeat with the other leg.

exerciseName: box jump down with one leg stabilization
instructions:
Step 1: Stand in front of a box or platform with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 2: Bend your knees and jump onto the box, landing softly with one foot on the box and the other foot hanging off the edge.
Step 3: Stabilize yourself on the box with the foot that is on it, while keeping the other foot off the ground.
Step 4: Hold this position for a few seconds, engaging your calf muscles to maintain balance.
Step 5: Slowly step down with the foot that is on the box, returning to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat the exercise with the other leg.

Step 1: Adjust the machine to your height and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 2: Place your shoulders under the pads and hold onto the handles for stability.
Step 3: Raise your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: cable standing one leg calf raise
instructions:
Step 1: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 2: Hold onto the cable machine for support.
Step 3: Lift one leg off the ground and balance on the other leg.
Step 4: Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

Step 1: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place the band around the ball of your left foot.
Step 2: Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
Step 3: Slowly raise your left heel off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the ball of your foot.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your left heel back down to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the right leg.

Step 1: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height just below your shoulders.
Step 2: Stand facing the bar with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing forward.
Step 3: Place the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or platform, with your heels hanging off.
Step 4: Hold onto the bar for support, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Step 5: Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Step 6: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Adjust the seat of the machine so that your shoulders are aligned with the lever pad.
Step 2: Place your toes on the lower portion of the platform and position your knees under the lever pad.
Step 3: Grasp the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Step 4: Press the lever pad down by extending your ankles, lifting your heels as high as possible.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: calf push stretch with hands against wall elite
instructions:
Step 1: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step 2: Place your hands against the wall at shoulder height.
Step 3: Step back with one foot, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Step 4: Bend your front knee slightly and lean forward, feeling a stretch in your calf.
Step 5: Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Step 6: Switch legs and repeat the stretch. Focus on elite movement.

exerciseName: triple style sled one leg calf press on leg press
instructions:
Step 1: Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the sled.
Step 2: Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the sled, shoulder-width apart.
Step 3: Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the sled, keeping your heels off.
Step 4: Push the sled forward by extending your ankles, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the sled back down by flexing your ankles.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions. Perform with triple intensity.

exerciseName: dumbbell seated one leg calf raise - hammer grip deep
instructions:
Step 1: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your thighs.
Step 2: Place one foot on a raised surface, such as a step or block, with your heel hanging off the edge.
Step 3: Hold the dumbbell with a hammer grip, meaning your palms are facing each other and your fingers are wrapped around the handle.
Step 4: Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, slowly raise your heel as high as possible by pushing through the ball of your foot.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Step 6: (deep variation) Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.

exerciseName: targeted style single leg calf raise (on a dumbbell)
instructions:
Step 1: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Step 2: Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Step 3: Slowly raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles. Emphasize targeted control.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.

Step 1: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Step 2: Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Step 3: As you push back up, lift one leg off the ground and kick it out to the side, keeping it straight.
Step 4: Lower your leg back down and repeat the push-up, then switch to the other leg.
Step 5: Continue alternating leg kicks with each push-up repetition.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step 2: Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Step 3: Lower your body by bending both knees until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Step 4: Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat with your left leg.
Step 6: Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your ankles.
Step 2: Hold the band with both hands in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Step 3: Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and slowly lower your upper body towards the ground.
Step 4: As you lower, push your hips back and allow your knees to bend slightly.
Step 5: Lower the band towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Step 6: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your upper body back up to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell close to your chest with both hands.
Step 2: Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by bending at the knees and hips.
Step 3: Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Place the bosu ball on the ground with the flat side up.
Step 2: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and position yourself on top of the bosu ball.
Step 3: Lower your body down by bending your knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Step 4: Keep your chest up and your weight on your heels.
Step 5: Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Step 6: Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step 2: Extend one leg forward and keep it off the ground throughout the exercise.
Step 3: Bend your standing leg and lower your body down as if sitting back into a chair.
Step 4: Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step 2: Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps or rear delts.
Step 3: Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower your body down.
Step 4: Bend at the knees and hips, pushing your hips back and down as if sitting into a chair.
Step 5: Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Step 6: Keep your knees in line with your toes and your weight in your heels.
Step 7: Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Step 8: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle.
Step 2: Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footrests.
Step 3: Place your hands on the side handles for stability.
Step 4: Engage your abductors and slowly push your legs apart, away from the midline of your body.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your legs back together to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell on the floor in front of you.
Step 2: Bend your knees and hinge at the hips to lower down and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step 3: Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees to lift the barbell off the floor, keeping it close to your body.
Step 4: As the barbell reaches your thighs, explosively extend your hips, shrug your shoulders, and pull the barbell up towards your chest.
Step 5: As the barbell reaches chest height, quickly drop under it and catch it at shoulder level, with your elbows pointing forward and your palms facing up.
Step 6: From the catch position, press the barbell overhead by extending your arms and pushing the barbell straight up.
Step 7: Lower the barbell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended to the sides.
Step 2: Keeping your legs straight, bend forward at the waist and reach down towards your toes with your right hand.
Step 3: As you reach down, simultaneously lift your left leg straight up behind you, maintaining balance.
Step 4: Return to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left hand reaching towards your toes and your right leg lifting up behind you.
Step 5: Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Lie face down on the ground with your legs extended.
Step 2: Bend your left knee and reach back with your left hand to grab your left foot or ankle.
Step 3: Gently pull your left foot towards your glutes, feeling a stretch in your left quad.
Step 4: Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then release.
Step 5: Repeat with your right leg.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Step 2: Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing your torso to lean forward.
Step 3: Continue lowering the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your torso back up to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support
instructions:
Step 1: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand.
Step 2: Place your left foot on a stepbox or elevated surface behind you.
Step 3: Keeping your back straight and core engaged, hinge forward at the hips, lowering the dumbbell towards the ground.
Step 4: As you lower the dumbbell, simultaneously lift your left leg behind you, maintaining a straight line from head to heel.
Step 5: Lower the dumbbell until you feel a stretch in your right hamstring, then return to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

Step 1: Place a band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Step 2: Stand facing a step or platform with your feet hip-width apart.
Step 3: Step up onto the platform with your right foot, pushing through your heel.
Step 4: Extend your left leg behind you, keeping it straight.
Step 5: Lower your left foot back down to the ground.
Step 6: Repeat with your left foot stepping up onto the platform.
Step 7: Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand.
Step 2: Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot slightly off the ground.
Step 3: Keeping your back straight, hinge forward at the hips and lower the dumbbell towards the ground.
Step 4: At the same time, extend your right leg straight behind you, maintaining a slight bend in your left knee.
Step 5: Lower the dumbbell until your torso and right leg are parallel to the ground.
Step 6: Pause for a moment, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

Step 1: Lie face down on a stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your legs extended straight behind you.
Step 2: Place your hands on the ground in front of you for stability.
Step 3: Engaging your glutes and hamstrings, lift your legs up towards the ceiling as high as you can.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Set up a barbell on a squat rack at chest height.
Step 2: Stand facing away from the rack, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 3: Bend your knees and lower your body down into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Step 4: Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step 5: Lift the barbell off the rack and step back, ensuring your feet are still shoulder-width apart.
Step 6: Lower your body down into a squat, keeping your knees in line with your toes.
Step 7: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 8: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Adjust the machine to fit your body and select the desired weight.
Step 2: Lie face down on the machine with your legs straight and your heels against the padded lever.
Step 3: Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Step 4: Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up as far as possible without lifting your hips off the pad.
Step 5: Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Step 6: Inhale and slowly lower the lever back to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Step 2: Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Step 3: Keeping your back straight, hinge forward at the hips, pushing your glutes back.
Step 4: Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Step 5: Engage your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Step 2: Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step 3: Bend at the hips, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Step 4: Lower the barbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body.
Step 5: Feel the stretch in your hamstrings as you lower the barbell.
Step 6: Once you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, push your hips forward and stand up straight.
Step 7: Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
Step 8: Lower the barbell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Start by lying on your back with your legs extended and the kettlebell held in your right hand, arm fully extended above your shoulder.
Step 2: Bend your right knee and place your right foot flat on the ground, keeping your left leg extended.
Step 3: Pressing through your right foot, lift your hips off the ground, coming into a bridge position.
Step 4: Slide your left leg underneath your body, bending your left knee and placing your left foot flat on the ground.
Step 5: Rotate your torso to the left, bringing your left hand to the ground for support.
Step 6: Pressing through your right foot and left hand, lift your torso off the ground, coming into a kneeling position.
Step 7: From the kneeling position, stand up, keeping the kettlebell extended overhead.
Step 8: Reverse the movement to return to the starting position.
Step 9: Repeat the exercise on the other side, starting with the kettlebell in your left hand.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step 2: Place the barbell on your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Step 3: Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to squat down, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Step 4: Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Step 5: Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step 2: Hold the kettlebell with both hands in front of your chest, close to your body.
Step 3: Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your hips down and back, as if sitting into a chair.
Step 4: Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Step 5: Drive through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Step 2: Bend your right knee and place your right ankle on your left thigh, just above the knee.
Step 3: Grasp your left thigh with both hands and gently pull it towards your chest.
Step 4: Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Step 5: Release and repeat on the other side.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Step 2: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body, arms extended downwards.
Step 3: Bend at your hips and knees, lowering the dumbbells towards the ground while keeping your back straight.
Step 4: Push through your heels and extend your hips and knees, lifting the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Step 2: Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Step 3: Lower the dumbbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body.
Step 4: Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, driving the dumbbell upwards in a straight line.
Step 5: As the dumbbell reaches shoulder height, quickly rotate your hand and punch it overhead, fully extending your arm.
Step 6: Catch the dumbbell overhead with a slight bend in your knees and hips.
Step 7: Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Step 8: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.

Step 1: Stand facing away from a suspension trainer with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 2: Extend one leg forward and place the top of your foot in the foot cradle of the suspension trainer.
Step 3: Bend your standing leg and lower your body down into a lunge position, keeping your chest up and your knee in line with your toes.
Step 4: Push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

Step 1: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Step 2: Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the foot platform.
Step 3: Position your feet wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step 4: Push against the foot platform to extend your legs and straighten your knees.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bend your knees to return to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: single leg bridge with outstretched leg
instructions:
Step 1: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Step 2: Extend one leg straight out in front of you.
Step 3: Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Step 4: Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

Step 1: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing outwards.
Step 2: Place a barbell on the ground in front of you, centered between your feet.
Step 3: Bend your knees and lower your hips, keeping your back straight and chest up, to grip the barbell with an overhand grip.
Step 4: Engage your core and drive through your heels to lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees simultaneously.
Step 5: As you lift, keep your chest up and back straight, and push your hips forward to fully engage your glutes.
Step 6: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Step 2: Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Step 3: Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
Step 4: While maintaining the side plank position, lift your top leg towards the ceiling, keeping it straight.
Step 5: Slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 2: Take a step diagonally behind and across your body with your right foot, crossing it behind your left leg.
Step 3: Bend both knees as if you were curtsying, lowering your body towards the ground.
Step 4: Keep your torso upright and your weight on your front foot.
Step 5: Push through your front foot to return to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat on the other side, stepping diagonally behind and across your body with your left foot.

Step 1: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Step 2: Place your lower legs under the padded lever, just above your ankles.
Step 3: Grasp the handles on the sides of the machine for support.
Step 4: Keeping your upper legs stationary, exhale and curl your legs up as far as possible.
Step 5: Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Step 6: Inhale and slowly lower the lever back to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Step 2: Place a resistance band just above your knees.
Step 3: Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Step 4: Press your heels into the ground and lift your hips off the floor, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: resistance band hip thrusts on knees (female)
instructions:
Step 1: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart and your feet flexed.
Step 2: Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Step 3: Place your hands on your hips or extend them out in front of you for balance.
Step 4: Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Step 5: Push your hips forward and squeeze your glutes as you lift your knees off the ground, extending your hips until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Step 6: Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your knees back down to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Lie on your side with your legs straight.
Step 2: Bend your top leg and grab your ankle or foot with your hand.
Step 3: Gently pull your ankle or foot towards your glutes until you feel a stretch in your quads.
Step 4: Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Step 5: Release the stretch and repeat on the other side.

Step 1: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Step 2: Bend your bottom leg slightly for stability.
Step 3: Place your top foot on a stable surface, such as a bench or step.
Step 4: Keeping your top leg straight, slowly lower it towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your inner thigh.
Step 5: Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Step 6: Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

exerciseName: squat to overhead reach with twist
instructions:
Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Step 2: Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Step 3: As you come up from the squat, raise your arms overhead and twist your torso to one side.
Step 4: Return to the starting position and repeat the squat, this time twisting your torso to the opposite side.
Step 5: Continue alternating sides with each squat repetition.

Step 1: Stand in front of the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 2: Place one foot behind you on a bench or step, with your toes pointing forward.
Step 3: Hold onto the smith machine bar for stability.
Step 4: Bend your front knee and lower your body down into a lunge position, keeping your back straight.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

Step 1: Start by kneeling on the ground with your feet hip-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Step 2: Hold a barbell across your upper back, resting it on your shoulders.
Step 3: Engage your core and glutes, then explosively jump up into the air, extending your hips and knees.
Step 4: As you jump, push through your toes and fully extend your ankles, knees, and hips.
Step 5: Land softly back on the ground, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Step 6: Immediately go into the next repetition, repeating the jump squat motion.

Step 1: Sit on the edge of a chair with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Step 2: Extend one leg straight out in front of you, keeping your heel on the ground.
Step 3: Lean forward slightly, feeling a stretch in your quadriceps.
Step 4: Hold this position for 20-30 seconds.
Step 5: Switch legs and repeat the stretch.

Step 1: Adjust the seat of the sled machine so that your knees are at a 45-degree angle.
Step 2: Sit on the sled machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Step 3: Grip the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Step 4: Push the footplate away from your body by extending your legs, keeping your heels on the footplate.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the fully extended position.
Step 6: Slowly bend your knees and lower the footplate back towards your body, controlling the movement.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Step 2: Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Step 3: Once you reach the bottom of the squat, explode upwards by jumping off the ground.
Step 4: As you jump, extend your hips, knees, and ankles, pushing through your toes.
Step 5: Land softly back into the squat position and immediately repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting on your upper back.
Step 2: Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your torso upright.
Step 3: Lower your body by bending your right knee until your thigh is parallel to the ground.
Step 4: Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat with your left leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step 2: Keeping your chest up and core engaged, slowly lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Step 3: Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Step 2: Hold the barbell with a wide grip, positioning it overhead with your arms fully extended.
Step 3: Engage your core and lower your body down into a squat position, keeping your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step 2: Hold the barbell in front of your chest with your hands shoulder-width apart, elbows pointing forward.
Step 3: Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Step 4: Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: exercise ball one leg prone lower body rotation
instructions:
Step 1: Lie face down on the stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your legs extended straight behind you.
Step 2: Place your hands on the ground in front of you for support.
Step 3: Engage your glutes and core muscles to stabilize your body.
Step 4: Slowly lift one leg off the ground, keeping it straight and parallel to the floor.
Step 5: Rotate your leg outward, away from your body, while keeping your hips and upper body stable.
Step 6: Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat the rotation with the other leg.
Step 8: Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Adjust the seat height and foot platform to your desired position.
Step 2: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the foot platform.
Step 3: Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Step 4: Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and push through your heels to lift the weight up.
Step 5: Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
Step 6: Extend your hips fully at the top of the movement, squeezing your glutes.
Step 7: Lower the weight back down in a controlled manner, keeping tension on your glutes and hamstrings.
Step 8: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle attachment is at the lowest setting.
Step 2: Lie face down on the bench with your legs straight and the ankle attachment secured to your ankles.
Step 3: Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Step 4: Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes by flexing your knees.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Step 6: Inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Step 2: Take a large step forward with your right foot, keeping your torso upright.
Step 3: Lower your body by bending your knees and hips until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Step 4: Pause for a moment, then push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat with your left leg forward for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell resting on your upper back.
Step 2: Keeping your chest up and core engaged, slowly lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Step 3: Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Step 4: Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, with the band placed just above your knees.
Step 2: Keeping your chest up and core engaged, push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat position.
Step 3: Make sure your knees are tracking over your toes and your weight is in your heels.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: intermediate hip flexor and quad stretch
instructions:
Step 1: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 2: Hold onto a stable object for support.
Step 3: Bend your right knee and bring your right foot towards your glutes, grabbing the rope with your right hand.
Step 4: Slowly pull your right foot towards your glutes, feeling a stretch in your right quad.
Step 5: Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Step 6: Release the stretch and repeat on the left side.

Step 1: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to a comfortable position.
Step 2: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step 3: Place the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Step 4: Engage your core and keep your chest up as you slowly lower your body by bending your knees and hips.
Step 5: Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Step 6: Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: barbell squat jump step rear lunge
instructions:
Step 1: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Step 2: Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Step 3: Explode upwards, jumping off the ground as high as you can.
Step 4: Land softly on your feet and immediately step back with one leg into a reverse lunge.
Step 5: Lower your body down until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
Step 6: Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat the jump and lunge sequence on the other leg.
Step 8: Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell across your upper back.
Step 2: Lift one foot off the ground and extend it forward, keeping it parallel to the ground.
Step 3: Bend your standing leg and lower your body down as if sitting back into a chair, keeping your chest up and your back straight.
Step 4: Lower yourself until your thigh is parallel to the ground, then push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Step 2: Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing a slight bend in your knees.
Step 3: Lower the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then squeeze your glutes and push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 4: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Step 2: Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Step 3: Place your hands on the sides of the chair or bench for support.
Step 4: Engage your abductors (outer thigh muscles) and slowly push your knees apart, against the resistance of the band.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your knees back together.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Step 2: Place your feet on the footrests and grasp the handles for stability.
Step 3: Engage your adductor muscles and slowly bring your legs together, squeezing your inner thighs.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand facing away from the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 2: Grab the rope attachment with both hands and step forward, creating tension in the cable.
Step 3: Bend at the hips and lower your upper body until it is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
Step 4: Engage your glutes and hamstrings to pull your body back up to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step 2: Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps or rear delts.
Step 3: Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your hips back and down, as if sitting into a chair.
Step 4: Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Step 5: Drive through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step 2: Take a step backward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Step 3: Bend your left knee and lower your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground.
Step 4: Pause for a moment, then push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat on the other side, stepping back with your left foot.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the tire.
Step 2: Bend your knees and hinge at the hips, lowering into a squat position.
Step 3: Reach down and grab the bottom edge of the tire with both hands, fingers facing towards you.
Step 4: Engage your glutes and leg muscles, and explosively drive through your legs to lift the tire off the ground.
Step 5: As the tire flips over, use your upper body strength to guide it and maintain control.
Step 6: Once the tire is fully flipped, quickly step back and reset your stance.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Step 2: Bring your right knee towards your right elbow, keeping it off the ground.
Step 3: As you bring your right knee back, simultaneously lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows.
Step 4: Push back up to the starting position and repeat with your left knee towards your left elbow.
Step 5: Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: band straight back stiff leg deadlift
instructions:
Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your upper legs.
Step 2: Hold the band with both hands in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Step 3: Keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent, hinge at the hips and lower the band towards the ground.
Step 4: Feel the stretch in your hamstrings as you lower the band.
Step 5: Engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your body back up to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Adjust the machine to fit your body and select the desired weight.
Step 2: Kneel on the machine facing downwards, with your knees resting on the pad and your feet secured under the footpads.
Step 3: Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Step 4: Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes by flexing your knees.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Step 6: Inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position, fully extending your knees.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Step 2: Place a barbell across your shoulders, gripping it with an overhand grip and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step 3: Engage your core and keep your chest lifted as you slowly lower your body down by bending your knees, keeping your back straight.
Step 4: Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and a barbell resting on your upper back.
Step 2: Keep your back straight and your chest up.
Step 3: Slowly hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso towards the ground.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and toes pointing slightly outward.
Step 2: Hold a weight in front of your chest with both hands.
Step 3: Shift your weight to one side and lower your body by bending the knee of the side you shifted towards, while keeping the other leg straight.
Step 4: Go as low as you can while maintaining balance and keeping your chest up.
Step 5: Push through the heel of the bent leg to return to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat on the other side, alternating between legs.

Step 1: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at hip height.
Step 2: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing outwards.
Step 3: Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper back and shoulders.
Step 4: Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Step 5: Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Step 6: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Lie face down on a mat or bench with your legs fully extended.
Step 2: Have a partner or use a resistance band to secure your ankles.
Step 3: Engage your hamstrings and lift your legs towards your glutes, keeping your knees straight.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Step 2: Place your hands by your sides for support.
Step 3: Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Step 4: While keeping your hips lifted, twist your lower body to the right side, bringing your knees towards the ground.
Step 5: Return to the starting position and repeat the twist to the left side.
Step 6: Continue alternating twists for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Step 2: Hold a barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Step 3: Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, bending at the knees and hips.
Step 4: As you lower, push your knees out to the sides and keep your weight on your heels.
Step 5: Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at an appropriate height for your squat.
Step 2: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step 3: Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper traps and shoulders.
Step 4: Grip the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step 5: Engage your core and unrack the barbell, stepping back to clear the rack.
Step 6: Keeping your chest up and back straight, initiate the squat by bending at the hips and knees.
Step 7: Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Step 8: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Step 9: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell on the ground in front of you.
Step 2: Bend your knees and hinge at the hips to lower into a squat position, gripping the barbell with an overhand grip.
Step 3: Keep your back straight and chest up as you drive through your heels to lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees.
Step 4: As the barbell reaches hip level, explosively pull it upwards, shrugging your shoulders and pulling your elbows high and to the sides.
Step 5: As the barbell reaches its highest point, quickly drop underneath it, pulling yourself into a deep squat position.
Step 6: Catch the barbell overhead with your arms fully extended and your knees bent.
Step 7: Stand up by extending your hips and knees, keeping the barbell overhead.
Step 8: Lower the barbell back down to the starting position by reversing the movement.
Step 9: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Step 2: Shift your weight onto your left foot and lift your right foot slightly off the ground.
Step 3: Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your right leg extended behind you for balance.
Step 4: Lower the barbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body and your left leg slightly bent.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your torso back up to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exerciseName: glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
instructions:
Step 1: Sit on the edge of a bench with your back against it and your feet flat on the ground.
Step 2: Place your hands on the bench beside your hips for support.
Step 3: Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then lift your hips off the bench until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight in each hand.
Step 2: Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Step 3: As you lunge forward, swing the weights forward and upward, keeping your arms straight.
Step 4: Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position, swinging the weights back down.
Step 5: Repeat with your left foot and continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a resistance band around your ankles.
Step 2: Take a big step forward with your right foot and a smaller step back with your left foot.
Step 3: Bend your knees and lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your left knee slightly above the ground.
Step 4: Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Step 5: Repeat on the other side.

Step 1: Start with the barbell resting on your shoulders, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step 2: Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Step 3: As you reach the bottom of the squat, explosively drive through your legs and push the barbell overhead.
Step 4: As the barbell reaches its peak, quickly drop into a split position, with one foot forward and one foot back.
Step 5: Catch the barbell overhead with your arms fully extended and your back knee slightly touching the ground.
Step 6: Stand up from the split position, bringing your feet back together.
Step 7: Lower the barbell back to your shoulders and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exerciseName: hands reversed clasped circular toe touch (male)
instructions:
Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended to the sides.
Step 2: Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Step 3: Reach down with your hands and clasp them together behind your legs.
Step 4: Slowly raise your hands up and over your head in a circular motion, keeping your legs straight.
Step 5: Continue the circular motion until your hands touch your toes.
Step 6: Reverse the motion and bring your hands back down to the starting position.
Step 7: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Start by lying flat on your back on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Step 2: Place a barbell across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
Step 3: Engage your glutes and core muscles, then lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Step 4: Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Step 5: Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Step 2: Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Step 3: Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
Step 4: While keeping your core engaged, lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips.
Step 5: Pause for a moment at the top, then lower your leg back down.
Step 6: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

Step 1: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and a dumbbell resting on your lower abdomen.
Step 2: Bend your knees and bring the dumbbell towards your glutes, keeping your feet flat on the ground.
Step 3: Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Step 4: Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Step 1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
